notes:
Bluetooth speakers: a paired Bluetooth speaker can now be used as an MCS source and as a wireless zone. It keeps its place while switched off or unplugged, and is silent unless a powered zone has selected it.
Bluetooth speaker buttons: pause, next and previous on the speaker now control the music playing to it. Resuming after a pause is still done from the app.
Wireless zones: the Wireless page lists Bluetooth and AirPlay speakers together, and wireless zones select sources, clear them and follow transport controls like any other zone.
AirPlay: speaker names with accented or non-English characters now display correctly.
Config: on the Aux page, Save and Undo sit beside the table, and the wait-one-minute notice appears in red as soon as you press Save.
